tools.name: get_bazi_chart
tools.description: Calculates the Four Pillars (BaZi) chart for a birth date, an optional birth time and the birthplace time zone. Returns the year, month, day and hour pillars, the Day Master, each stem's Ten Gods relation to it, the hidden stems in each branch and the five-element count.

tools.name: get_zodiac_year
tools.description: Returns the Chinese zodiac year for a birth date or a calendar year: the animal, Heavenly Stem, element, yin or yang, the Chinese New Year dates that open and close the year and the Li Chun date. A birth date also reports whether Chinese New Year and Li Chun give different animals.

tools.name: check_animal_compatibility
tools.description: Compares two Chinese zodiac animals, or the animals of two birth years, and names their relationship: Six Harmony, Three Harmony, clash, harm, break, punishment or neutral. Returns the relation types, the phase interaction, the distance on the twelve-animal circle and a written reading of the pair.

tools.name: count_five_elements
tools.description: Counts Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water across the visible characters of the Four Pillars chart for a birth date, with an optional birth time and UTC offset. Returns each count with its relation to the Day Master, the leading element, the elements missing from view and the Day Master.

tools.name: get_kua_number
tools.description: Returns the feng shui Kua number for a birth date and calculation table: its trigram, element, East or West group, and the four favourable and four unfavourable directions. Birthdays before Chinese New Year use the preceding Chinese year.

tools.name: cast_i_ching
tools.description: Reads an I Ching hexagram from six line values, bottom line first: 6 is a changing Yin line, 7 a Yang line, 8 a Yin line and 9 a changing Yang line. Without line values it makes a random three-coin cast. Returns the primary and relating hexagrams, the changing lines and their classical texts.

tools.name: get_zi_wei_chart
tools.description: Builds a Zi Wei Dou Shu chart for a birth date, a birth time and a traditional calculation table. Returns the lunar date, the Five Element bureau, the Life and Body palace branches and the major stars with their brightness and transformations in each of the twelve palaces.

tools.name: get_flying_stars
tools.description: Returns the annual Flying Stars chart for a year: the star in each of the nine palaces, the centre star and the moment Li Chun begins the year. The grid has south at the top.
